# Ponder

> An AI-powered research workspace for knowledge management, literature review, and collaborative team thinking.

Ponder is an intelligent platform that combines mind mapping, whiteboard collaboration, and AI-assisted research tools to help researchers, students, and teams organize knowledge, synthesize information, and generate insights. The workspace integrates document analysis, knowledge graphs, and visual thinking capabilities to streamline research workflows.

## Key Topics

- AI Research Tool
- Mind Mapping
- Knowledge Management
- Literature Review
- Team Collaboration
- Whiteboard AI

- AI Canvas

## Core Features

- [AI Research Tool](https://ponder.ing/features/ai-research-tool): Intelligent Research Assistant for document analysis, literature reviews, and knowledge synthesis with automated summarization and insight generation
- [Mind Mapping AI](https://ponder.ing/features/mind-mapping-ai): Smart AI Mind Map Generator for converting PDFs, videos, and ideas into visual maps for brainstorming and idea organization
- [Whiteboard AI](https://ponder.ing/features/whiteboard-ai): Interactive AI Whiteboard for collaborative ideation, visual thinking, and real-time team productivity

## Getting Started
